paragraphs: Ingram Micro is a leading solutions provider by revenue and/or by global footprint for the global information technology ("IT") ecosystem helping power the world's leading technology brands. With our vast infrastructure and focus on client and endpoint solutions, advanced solutions offerings, cloud-based and other solutions, we enable our business partners to scale and operate more efficiently in the markets they serve. We are at the center of the technology ecosystem and deliver customized solutions to our vendor and reseller partners, enabling them to provide excellent business outcomes to the end-user companies and consumers they serve. Through our global reach, our industry-leading business-to-business ("B2B") platform, and our broad portfolio of products, professional services offerings and software, cloud and digital solutions, we remove complexity and maximize the value of the technology products our partners make, sell or use, providing the world more ways to realize the promise of technology. While many commercial markets remain economically volatile around the globe, our business remains well-positioned to benefit from technology megatrends, including cloud migration, enhanced security needs, automation and robotics, artificial intelligence ("AI") and machine learning ("ML") enabling Agentic AI, hyperconnected ecosystems, hybrid work and Internet-of-Things ("IoT"). Our business is organized into four reportable segments based on the different geographic regions in which we operate: North America; Europe, Middle East and Africa ("EMEA"); Asia-Pacific; and Latin America.

Our Fiscal Year is a 52- or 53-week period ending on the Saturday nearest to December 31. All references herein to "Fiscal Year 2025", "Fiscal Year 2024" and "Fiscal Year 2023" represent the fiscal years ended December 27, 2025 (52 weeks), December 28, 2024 (52 weeks) and December 30, 2023 (52 weeks), respectively.

We are a technology-focused company and have invested heavily in developing and acquiring technology, including intellectual property, to enable our partners' success. We expect our continued investment in robotics and automation within our advanced logistics centers will augment our efficient, customer-centric delivery capabilities and that our continued investment in our digital capabilities, including the integration of more than 42 million lines of code and 400 AI and ML models within Ingram Micro Xvantage, which is enhancing and will continue to enrich the experience of our customers and vendors. We have a proven track record of profitable growth which has enabled us to achieve a position of great competitive strength and remain focused on continuing to deliver strong future growth. We recognize the market's need for sophisticated IT solutions and our strategies are developed with this in mind. Our overall objective is to continue to expand our business and our profitability by delivering innovative and thoughtful solutions to enable business partners to scale and operate more efficiently and successfully in the markets they serve through the ecosystem created by our end-to-end Xvantage platform.
Our strategic priorities are aligned to achieve this objective and focus on:

•Adding digital tools and services to deepen engagement with customers and vendors and continuing to develop a transformative, fully digital platform to further simplify, automate, digitize and scale the delivery of our products and solutions portfolio. Through our Xvantage platform, we deliver a singular business-to-consumer-like experience to our vendor and customer partners in the B2B market to interact, learn, partner, plan and consume technology via seamless and autonomous engines.

•Growing our emerging technologies practices, including cybersecurity and AI, and further extending our technology portfolio to build out additional higher value, more complex product and services offerings.
•Enhancing profitability through operational improvement initiatives, digitization and automation.

We provide a broad line of technology, services and solutions from approximately 1,500 vendor partners, enabling us to offer comprehensive solutions to our reseller customers. Our suppliers are the world's most trusted technology leaders, along with emerging technology brands, which include the industry's premier hyperscalers, computer hardware suppliers, mobility hardware suppliers, networking equipment suppliers and software publishers such as Microsoft, Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, NVIDIA, Advanced Micro Devices, Apple, Cisco, Dell Technologies, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, HP Inc., Lenovo, and Super Micro Computer.

We also work with suppliers of computer peripherals, consumer electronics, cloud-based solutions, unified communication and collaboration, data capture/point-of-sale ("DC / POS"), cybersecurity, and physical security products. Our cloud portfolio comprises third-party services and subscriptions spanning a breadth of products from solution software to infrastructure-as-a-service. Our Ingram Micro Cloud Marketplace service portfolio consists of third-party cloud-based services or subscription offerings sold through our own platform. Vendors on the platform include Proofpoint, Amazon Web Services, Microsoft, Cisco and Adobe. We sell products purchased from many vendors, but generated approximately 21%, 19% and 16% of our consolidated net sales in Fiscal Year 2025, Fiscal Year 2024 and Fiscal Year 2023, respectively, from products purchased from Apple Inc. Additionally, we generated approximately 9%, 10%, and 10% of our consolidated net sales in Fiscal Year 2025, Fiscal Year 2024, and Fiscal Year 2023, respectively, from products purchased from HP Inc. We also generated approximately 10%, 7%, and 7% of our consolidated net sales during the Fiscal Year 2025, Fiscal Year 2024 and Fiscal Year 2023, respectively, from products purchased from Lenovo.

Our cloud marketplace, which in many key markets has already been integrated into one unified Ingram Micro Xvantage platform, connects partners with what we believe to be the world's largest cloud ecosystem, enabling them to generate demand more efficiently and provide third-party cloud-based services and subscription offerings through a digital platform for the consumption of cloud solutions in an ever-increasing cloud-centric world. We support more than 200 cloud solutions and manage over 40 million seats through our cloud marketplace. Our professional services offerings add value to our partners and customers by providing data-driven business and market insights, pre-sales engineering, post-sale integration, technical support, trade credit, and financing solutions to further grow their businesses. In addition, our IT Asset Disposition ("ITAD") and Reverse Logistics and Repairs businesses play an important role in advancing environmental sustainability and bridging the digital divide through electronic device reverse logistics, refurbishment, recycling, reuse and resale for organizations, including the world's largest mobile telecommunication providers. By helping to enable a circular economy, we help our customers in achieving their sustainability goals and enable consumers to access high-quality, affordable smartphones, computers and other devices.
We categorize our product and service offerings into the following categories, each of which is offered in each of our four geographic segments:

•Client and Endpoint Solutions. We offer a variety of higher-volume products targeted for corporate and individual end users, including desktop personal computers, notebooks, tablets, printers, components (including hard drives, motherboards, video cards, etc.), application software, peripherals, and accessories. We also offer a variety of products that enable mobile computing and productivity, including phones, phone tablets (including two-in-one "notebook/tablet" devices), smartphones, feature phones, mobile phone accessories, wearables and mobility software.

•Advanced Solutions. We offer enterprise-grade hardware and software products aimed at corporate and enterprise users and generally characterized by specific projects, which generally account for lower volumes than Client and Endpoint Solutions but higher margins individually and collectively in the form of solutions and related services. And while Advanced Solutions offerings often require higher operational expenditures, primarily in the form of technical capabilities to serve the market, the operating margin delivered by this business is also generally stronger than Client and Endpoint Solutions. Within this product category, we offer servers, storage, networking, hybrid and software-defined solutions, cybersecurity, and power and cooling solutions. This category also includes training, professional services and financing solutions related to these product sets. We also offer customers AI-related products and offerings, DC / POS, physical security, audio visual & digital signage, Unified Communications and Collaboration ("UCC"), and IoT (smart office/home automation) products.

•Cloud-based Solutions: Our cloud portfolio comprises third-party services and subscriptions spanning a breadth of products from solution software through infrastructure-as-a-service. As technology consumption increasingly moves to anything-as-a-service, we have expanded our cloud solutions to more than 200 third-party cloud-based services or subscription offerings, including business applications, security, communications and collaboration, cloud enablement solutions and infrastructure-as-a-service. Also included here have been the offerings of our CloudBlue business, which provided customers with multichannel and multi-tier catalog management, subscription management, billing and orchestration capabilities through a software-as-a-service model. Our CloudBlue operations were sold during the third quarter of 2025.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Our Industry
Our quarterly results have fluctuated significantly.
Our acquisition and investment strategies may not produce the expected benefits, which may adversely affect our results of operations.

We are a holding company with no direct operations. Our sole material asset is our indirect equity interest in Ingram Micro Inc. and, as such, we will depend on our subsidiaries for cash to fund all of our expenses.
Failure to retain and recruit key personnel would harm our ability to meet key objectives.
Increases in wage and benefit costs, collective bargaining agreements, changes in laws and other labor regulations, or labor disruptions could impact our financial condition and cash flows.
Our failure to adequately adapt to industry changes could negatively impact our future operating results.
We continually experience intense competition across all markets for our products and services.
Our goodwill and identifiable intangible assets could become impaired, which could reduce the value of our assets and reduce our net income in the year in which the write-off occurs.
We cannot predict the outcome of litigation matters and other contingencies with which we may be involved from time to time.
We have been, and may continue to be, affected by public health issues.
Risks Related to the Macroeconomic and Regulatory Environment
We operate a global business that exposes us to risks associated with conducting business in multiple jurisdictions.
Our businesses operate in various international markets, including certain emerging markets that are subject to greater political, economic, and social uncertainties than developed countries.
Changes in macroeconomic and geopolitical conditions can affect our business and results of operations.
Tariffs, trade and non-trade restrictions may increase prices and could adversely affect our business, results of operations, financial condition, and cash flows.
U.S.-China tensions around technology, critical minerals, national security, and human rights continue to evolve and could adversely affect our business.
Our failure to comply with environmental, health and safety regulations or other applicable laws could adversely affect our business.
Changes in accounting rules could adversely affect our reported operating results.

paragraphs: An investment in our Common Stock involves a high degree of risk. A description of the risks and uncertainties associated with our business is set forth below. You should carefully consider the risks described below as well as the other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including our consolidated financial statements and the notes thereto, and "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations." The occurrence of any of the events or developments described below could adversely affect our business, results of operations, financial condition, cash flows, reputation, or growth prospects, which could, in turn, adversely affect our stock price. Additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or those we currently view to be immaterial could also present significant risks to our business. Investors should carefully consider all relevant risks before investing in our common stock.
The following summary provides an overview of the material risks to which we are exposed, as set forth in greater detail further below. These risks include, but are not limited to, the following:
•our ability to predict our results of operations, which may fluctuate significantly;
•our ability to continue to successfully develop, deploy, and operationalize Ingram Micro Xvantage;
•inflation and industry and market conditions, development, and volatility, including supply constraints across many elements of technology;
•the level of success of our acquisition and investment strategies;

paragraphs: The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements and related notes included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. In addition to historical consolidated financial information, the following discussion contains forward-looking statements that reflect our plans, estimates, and beliefs that involve significant risks and uncertainties. Our actual results could differ materially from those discussed in the forward-looking statements. Factors that could cause or contribute to those differences include those discussed below and elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, particularly in "Risk Factors" and "Cautionary Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements."

Our Fiscal Year is a 52- or 53-week period ending on the Saturday nearest to December 31. All references herein to "Fiscal Year 2025", "Fiscal Year 2024", and "Fiscal Year 2023" represent the fiscal years ended December 27, 2025 (52 weeks), December 28, 2024 (52 weeks), and December 30, 2023 (52 weeks), respectively. This section of this Annual Report on Form 10-K generally discusses fiscal years 2025 and 2024 items and year-over-year comparisons between fiscal years 2025 and 2024. Discussions of Fiscal Year 2023 items and year-over-year comparisons between Fiscal Year 2024 and Fiscal Year 2023 that are not included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K can be found in "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" of our Annual Report on Form 10-K filed with the SEC on March 5, 2025. All financial data included in this Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations section are in thousands, except as otherwise indicated.

Unless otherwise noted in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, the use of the terms "Ingram Micro," "we," "us," "our" and the "Company" refers to Ingram Micro Holding Corporation and its subsidiaries. The use of the term "Platinum" means Platinum Equity, LLC together with its affiliated investment vehicles.

Ingram Micro Holding Corporation and its subsidiaries are primarily engaged in the distribution of IT products, cloud and other services worldwide. Our business is organized into four reportable segments based on the different geographic regions in which we operate: North America; EMEA; Asia-Pacific; and Latin America.

We are dependent on global IT spend, which is influenced by broader economic trends and their impacts on enterprise spending, as well as new product introductions and product transitions by technology vendors. Driven by the rapid evolution of the technology industry, frequent fluctuations in market demand, and the increasing complexity of solutions, which often integrate offerings from multiple vendors and service providers, vendors increasingly rely on distributors to bring their products to market more efficiently along with providing value-added services. We have diverse relationships with many global vendors and offer a full suite of end-to-end solutions including comprehensive services, positioning us well to capture demand in key technology sectors. We expect to continue investing in our services offerings, as well as our relationships with existing and emerging vendors with the goal of expanding the breadth and depth of what we already believe to be the industry's most comprehensive offering.

The accelerating transition from on-premises software solutions to cloud-based solutions can drive a revenue mix shift to our higher margin cloud offerings. Because of our advanced capabilities and offerings, we believe this industry shift is a net positive for our business, and it demonstrates the comprehensive value of our business model. To capture this opportunity, we plan to continue investing in development and go-to-market support for our cloud offerings and marketplaces, including those already integrated into Ingram Micro Xvantage.

Our product, service and solution offerings consist of Client and Endpoint Solutions, Advanced Solutions, Cloud-based Solutions and Other, which include the product and service categories further described below. Our results are impacted by changes in demand levels and related product mix, including entry or expansion into new markets, new product offerings and the exit or retraction of certain business. Furthermore, we have invested most heavily in recent years into Advanced Solutions and Cloud-based Solutions and capabilities globally, for which an increased need for more complex solutions coupled with more products being consumed on an as-a-service basis is driving a more rapid shift towards these offerings. Advanced Solutions and Cloud sales now collectively comprise more than one-third of our net sales and more than half of our gross profit.

As part of our global presence in each of our four geographic regions, we offer customers a full spectrum of hardware and software, cloud-based solutions, services and logistics expertise through four main lines of business: Client and Endpoint Solutions, Advanced Solutions, Cloud-based Solutions and Other. In each of our geographic segments we offer customers the product categories listed below broken down under the respective line of business.

•Client and Endpoint Solutions. We offer a variety of higher-volume products targeted for corporate and individual end users, including desktop personal computers, notebooks, tablets, printers, components (including hard drives, motherboards, video cards, etc.), application software, peripherals, and accessories. We also offer a variety of products that enable mobile computing and productivity, including phones, phone tablets (including two-in-one "notebook/tablet" devices), smartphones, feature phones, mobile phone accessories, wearables and mobility software.

•Advanced Solutions. We offer enterprise-grade hardware and software products aimed at corporate and enterprise users and generally characterized by specific projects, which generally account for lower volumes than Client and Endpoint Solutions but higher margins individually and collectively in the form of solutions and related services. And while Advanced Solutions offerings often require higher operational expenditures, primarily in the form of technical capabilities to serve the market, the operating margin delivered by this business is also generally stronger than Client and Endpoint Solutions. Within this product category, we offer servers, storage, networking, hybrid and software-defined solutions, cybersecurity, and power and cooling solutions. This category also includes training, professional services and financing solutions related to these product sets. We also offer customers AI-related products and offerings, DC / POS, physical security, audio visual & digital signage, UCC, and IoT (smart office/home automation) products.

•Cloud-based Solutions. Our cloud portfolio comprises third-party services and subscriptions spanning a breadth of products from solution software through infrastructure-as-a-service. As technology consumption increasingly moves to anything-as-a-service, we have expanded our cloud solutions to more than 200 third-party cloud-based services or subscription offerings, including business applications, security, communications and collaboration, cloud enablement solutions and infrastructure-as-a-service. Also included here have been the offerings of our CloudBlue business, which provided customers with multichannel and multi-tier catalog management, subscription management, billing and orchestration capabilities through a software-as-a-service model. Our CloudBlue operations were sold during the third quarter of 2025.
•Other. We provide customers with ITAD, reverse logistics and repair and other related solutions. These offerings represent less than 5% of net sales for all periods presented herein.

End-market demand across IT products in each of the geographic regions in which we operate affects the relative mix of our revenues and may lead to fluctuations in our overall profitability. Vendors are increasingly focused on their global presence and we are consistently growing our share of the total addressable market with global vendors. Exposure to emerging markets, especially Asia-Pacific and Latin America, is driving higher growth and operating margin. Emerging markets typically require lower capital investment given less automation, and we typically experience higher operating margins in these markets due to their lower average labor costs.

Our vendors include many of the largest tech companies, including Advanced Micro Devices, Apple, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Cisco, Dell Technologies, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, HP Inc., Lenovo, Microsoft, NVIDIA and Super Micro Computer. Ingram Micro's access to products, especially when supply constraints exist, is enhanced by the strength of our long-standing relationships with vendors. Vendors typically select distributors based on global reach, scale, contract terms, the strength of partnerships and service capabilities offered.

headings: 本公司產品與解決方案
本公司商標與服務標誌
paragraphs: Ingram Micro 是全球資訊科技（"IT"）生態系中，以營業收入及/或全球據點為準的領導解決方案供應商，協助推動全球領先科技品牌的發展。憑藉我們龐大的基礎設施與專注於客戶與終端解決方案、先進解決方案產品、雲端及其他解決方案，我們使業務夥伴能在其服務市場中實現規模擴張與更高效的運作。我們處於科技生態系的核心，為我們的供應商與經銷商夥伴提供客製化解決方案，使其能為其所服務的終端企業與消費者帶來優秀的商業成果。透過我們的全球佈局、業界領先的企業對企業（"B2B"）平台，以及我們廣泛的產品組合、專業服務、軟體、雲端與數位解決方案，我們去除複雜性並最大化我們夥伴所製造、銷售或使用的科技產品價值，為世界提供更多實現科技潛力的方式。儘管許多商業市場在全球仍面臨總體經濟不穩定，我們的業務仍處於有利位置，可從科技大趨勢中受益，包括雲端遷移、增強的安全需求、自動化與機械人、人工智慧（"AI"）與機器學習（"ML"）所啟動的 Agentic AI、超連結生態系、混合工作與物聯網（"IoT"）。我們的業務依不同營運地理區域劃分為四個應報告分部：北美；歐洲、中東與非洲（"EMEA"）；亞太；以及拉丁美洲。
我們的會計年度為 52 或 53 週的期間，結於最接近 12 月 31 日的星期六。 herein 所提及的 "會計年度 2025"、"會計年度 2024" 和 "會計年度 2023" 代表結於 2025 年 12 月 27 日（52 週）、2024 年 12 月 28 日（52 週）和 2023 年 12 月 30 日（52 週）的會計年度。

我們是一家以科技為導向的公司，並已大量投資於開發與取得科技，包括智慧財產權，以協助我們的夥伴成功。我們預期持續投資於我們先進物流中心的機械人與自動化，將增強我們高效、以客戶為中心的交付能力，並持續投資於我們的數位能力，包括將超過 4200 萬行程式碼與 400 個 AI 與 ML 模型整合至 Ingram Micro Xvantage，這將提升並持續豐富我們客戶與供應商的體驗。我們有成功的獲利成長紀錄，使我們能取得強大的競爭優勢，並持續專注於實現強勁的未來成長。我們認知市場對高階 IT 解決方案的需求，並以此為基礎發展我們的策略。我們的總體目標是透過我們端到端 Xvantage 平台所建立的生態系，持續擴張我們的業務與獲利能力，為業務夥伴提供創新且深思熟慮的解決方案，使其能在其服務市場中實現規模擴張與更高效的運作與成功。
我們的戰略優先事項與實現此目標一致，並專注於：
•增加數位工具與服務，深化與客戶與供應商的互動，並持續發展一個轉型、完整的數位平台，以進一步簡化、自動化、數位化與擴展我們產品與解決方案組合的交付。透過我們的 Xvantage 平台，我們為 B2B 市場的供應商與客戶夥伴提供類似企業對消費者（B2C）的單一體驗，使其能透過順暢且自主的引擎進行互動、學習、合作、規劃與使用科技。
•擴展我們的創新科技業務，包括網路安全與 AI，並進一步拓展我們的科技組合，以建立更多高價值、更複雜的產品與服務組合。
•透過運營改善計畫、數位化與自動化來提升獲利能力。

我們提供來自約 1,500 家供應商夥伴的廣泛科技、服務與解決方案，使我們能為經銷商客戶提供完整的解決方案。我們的供應商為全球最受信賴的科技領導者，以及新興科技品牌，包括業界領先的超規模雲端服務供應商、電腦硬體供應商、行動硬體供應商、網路設備供應商與軟體發行商，例如 Microsoft、Amazon Web Services、Google Cloud、NVIDIA、Advanced Micro Devices、Apple、Cisco、Dell Technologies、Hewlett Packard Enterprise、HP Inc.、Lenovo 和 Super Micro Computer。

我們也與電腦週邊設備、消費性電子產品、雲端解決方案、統一通訊與協作、資料捕捉/零售點銷售（"DC / POS"）、網路安全及實體安全產品的供應商合作。我們的雲端產品組合包含第三方服務與訂閱方案，涵蓋從解決方案軟體到基礎設施即服務（Infrastructure-as-a-Service）的廣泛產品。我們的Ingram Micro Cloud Marketplace服務組合包含透過我們自有平台銷售的第三方雲端服務或訂閱方案。平台上的供應商包括Proofpoint、Amazon Web Services、Microsoft、Cisco及Adobe。我們銷售從許多供應商處購入的產品，但來自Apple Inc.購入產品的銷售額分別約佔我們財務年度2025、2024及2023的總淨銷售額21%、19%及16%。此外，我們來自HP Inc.購入產品的銷售額分別約佔我們財務年度2025、2024及2023的總淨銷售額9%、10%及10%。我們也來自Lenovo購入產品的銷售額分別約佔我們財務年度2025、2024及2023的總淨銷售額10%、7%及7%。

我們的雲端市場平台已在許多關鍵市場整合至一個統一的Ingram Micro Xvantage平台，連結合作夥伴與我們認為是全球最大的雲端生態系統，使其能更有效地產生需求，並透過數位平台提供第三方雲端服務與訂閱方案，以應對日益增長的雲端中心世界。我們支援超過200種雲端解決方案，並透過雲端市場平台管理超過4000萬個席位。我們的專業服務方案為合作夥伴與客戶提供價值，透過數據驅動的商業與市場洞察、售前工程、售後整合、技術支援、貿易信用及融資方案，進一步拓展其業務。此外，我們的資訊科技資產處置（"ITAD"）與逆向物流與維修業務在推動環境永續及縮小數位落差方面扮演重要角色，透過電子設備的逆向物流、翻新、回收、再利用及再銷售，協助組織，包括全球最大的行動電信業者。透過協助實現循環經濟，我們協助客戶達成其永續目標，並讓消費者能取得高品質且價格合理的智慧型手機、電腦及其他設備。
我們將產品與服務方案歸類為以下類別，每一類別均在我們的四大地理區段中提供：
•客戶與終端解決方案。我們提供多種高銷售量的產品，針對企業與個人終端使用者，包括桌上型個人電腦、筆記型電腦、平板電腦、印表機、零組件（包括硬碟、主機板、顯示卡等）、應用軟體、週邊設備及配件。我們也提供多種產品，用以實現行動計算與生產力，包括手機、平板電腦（包括二合一 "筆記型電腦/平板電腦" 裝置）、智慧型手機、功能手機、行動電話配件、穿戴式裝置及行動軟體。

•高階解決方案。我們提供企業級的硬體與軟體產品，針對企業與企業用戶，通常以特定專案為特徵，通常銷售量低於客戶與終端解決方案，但以解決方案及相關服務形式集體與個別而言，毛利率較高。雖然高階解決方案通常需要較高的運營支出，主要為技術能力以服務市場，但此業務的運營毛利率通常也高於客戶與終端解決方案。在這個產品類別中，我們提供伺服器、儲存、網路、混合與軟體定義解決方案、網路安全及電力與冷卻解決方案。這個類別也包括與這些產品組合相關的培訓、專業服務及融資解決方案。我們也提供客戶與AI相關的產品與方案、DC / POS、實體安全、音訊視訊與數位看板、統一通訊與協作（"UCC"）及物聯網（智慧辦公室/家庭自動化）產品。

•雲端解決方案：我們的雲端產品組合包含第三方服務與訂閱方案，涵蓋從解決方案軟體到基礎設施即服務（Infrastructure-as-a-Service）的廣泛產品。隨著科技消費逐漸轉向任何服務即服務（Anything-as-a-Service），我們已將雲端解決方案擴展至超過200種第三方雲端服務或訂閱方案，包括企業應用程式、安全、通訊與協作、雲端啟動解決方案及基礎設施即服務。此處也包含我們CloudBlue業務的產品方案，該業務透過軟體即服務模式，為客戶提供多渠道與多層級目錄管理、訂閱管理、計費及 orchestrating 能力。我們的CloudBlue業務於2025年第三季完成出售。

paragraphs: 以下對我們財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析，應與本年度10-K申報表中所包含的合併財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀。除了歷史合併財務資訊外，以下討論包含向前看的陳述，反映我們的計畫、預估與信念，這些陳述涉及重大風險與不確定性。我們的實際結果可能與向前看陳述中所討論的結果有重大差異。導致這些差異的因素包括以下所討論的內容及其他處於本年度10-K申報表中，特別是在『風險因素』與『向前看陳述的警示』部分。

我們的會計年度為一個52週或53週的期間，於接近12月31日的星期六結束。本報告中所提及的『會計年度2025』、『會計年度2024』與『會計年度2023』，分別代表於2025年12月27日（52週）、2024年12月28日（52週）與2023年12月30日（52週）結束的會計年度。本年度10-K申報表的此部分一般討論會計年度2025與2024的項目以及會計年度2025與2024之間的年對年比較。未包含於本年度10-K申報表中的會計年度2023項目以及會計年度2024與會計年度2023之間的年對年比較，可於我們於2025年3月5日提交給SEC的年度10-K申報表中『管理層對財務狀況與營運成果的討論與分析』部分找到。本『管理層對財務狀況與營運成果的討論與分析』部分所包含的財務資料均以千為單位，除非另有說明。
除非本年度10-K申報表另有說明，否則本報告中使用『Ingram Micro』、『我們』、『我們』、『我們』與『公司』這些詞彙，均指Ingram Micro Holding Corporation及其子公司。使用『Platinum』一詞，是指Platinum Equity, LLC及其附屬投資工具。
Ingram Micro Holding Corporation及其子公司主要從事全球資訊科技產品與雲端及其他服務的分銷業務。我們的業務根據我們營運的不同地理區域，分為四個應報告分部：北美；歐洲、中東及非洲（EMEA）；亞太；以及拉丁美洲。

我們依賴全球資訊科技支出，這受到更廣泛的總體經濟趨勢及其對企業支出的影響，以及科技供應商的新產品推出與產品過渡。由於科技產業的快速演進，市場需求頻繁波動，以及解決方案的日益複雜，這些解決方案通常整合來自多個供應商與服務提供者的產品與服務，供應商越來越依賴經銷商以更有效的方式將其產品推向市場，並提供附加價值服務。我們與許多全球供應商有廣泛的合作關係，並提供完整的端到端解決方案，包括全面的服務，使我們在關鍵科技領域的市場需求中處於優勢位置。我們預期會持續投資於我們的服務業務，以及與現有與新興供應商的關係，以擴展我們已經認為是產業最全面的解決方案的廣度與深度。
從本地端軟體解決方案轉向雲端解決方案的加速過渡，可能導致營收組成向我們高毛利率的雲端解決方案轉移。由於我們先進的能力與解決方案，我們認為這項產業轉變對我們的業務是正面的，並顯示出我們業務模式的全面價值。為抓住這個機會，我們計畫持續投資於我們雲端解決方案與市場的開發與推廣支持，包括已整合至Ingram Micro Xvantage的解決方案。

我們的產品、服務與解決方案業務包括客戶端與終端解決方案、高階解決方案、雲端解決方案與其他，這些包括以下進一步說明的產品與服務類別。我們的結果受到需求水平變動與相關產品組成的影響，包括進入或擴張新市場、新產品推出以及某些業務的退出或縮減。此外，我們近年來最重的投資在高階解決方案與雲端解決方案以及全球的相關能力，由於對更複雜解決方案的需求增加，以及越來越多產品以服務模式消費，這正在推動更快向這些解決方案轉移。高階解決方案與雲端解決方案的銷售現在共同佔據我們淨銷售額的超過三分之一，以及我們毛利率的超過一半。
作為我們在全球四大地理區域的業務存在的一部分，我們為客戶提供涵蓋硬體與軟體、雲端解決方案、服務與物流專業知識的完整產品組合，透過四大主要業務線：客戶端與終端解決方案、高階解決方案、雲端解決方案與其他。在每個地理區域分部中，我們為客戶提供下列產品類別，並根據相應的業務線進行分類。

•Client and Endpoint Solutions. 我們提供多種高用量的產品，針對企業及個人終端使用者，包括桌上型個人電腦、筆記型電腦、平板電腦、印表機、零組件（包括硬碟、主機板、顯示卡等）、應用軟體、外設器材及配件。我們也提供多種產品，用以實現行動計算與生產力，包括手機、行動電話平板（包括二合一 "筆記型電腦/平板" 裝置）、智慧型手機、功能手機、行動電話配件、穿戴式裝置及行動軟體。

•Advanced Solutions. 我們提供企業級的硬體與軟體產品，針對企業及企業使用者，通常以特定專案為特徵，這些產品通常用量低於 Client and Endpoint Solutions，但單獨或集體以解決方案及相關服務形式呈現時，毛利率較高。雖然 Advanced Solutions 的產品通常需要較高的運營支出，主要為技術能力以服務市場，但此業務的運營毛利率通常也高於 Client and Endpoint Solutions。在這個產品類別中，我們提供伺服器、儲存、網路、混合及軟體定義解決方案、網路安全及電力與散熱解決方案。這個類別也包含與這些產品組合相關的培訓、專業服務及融資解決方案。我們也提供客戶與人工智慧相關的產品與服務，DC/POS、實體安全、音訊視訊與數位看板、UCC 及 IoT（智慧辦公室/家庭自動化）產品。

•Cloud-based Solutions. 我們的雲端產品組合包含第三方服務與訂閱方案，涵蓋從解決方案軟體至基礎設施即服務的廣泛產品。隨著科技消費逐漸轉向任何東西即服務，我們已將雲端解決方案擴展至超過 200 個第三方雲端服務或訂閱方案，包括企業應用軟體、安全、通訊與協作、雲端啟動解決方案及基礎設施即服務。此處也包含我們 CloudBlue 事業所提供的服務，該事業透過軟體即服務模式，為客戶提供多渠道及多層級目錄管理、訂閱管理、計費及 orchestrating 能力。我們的 CloudBlue 事業於 2025 年第三季完成出售。
•Other. 我們為客戶提供 ITAD、逆向物流及維修及其他相關解決方案。這些服務在所有呈報期間內，佔淨銷售額的比例低於 5%。
各個營運地區的 IT 產品需求，會影響我們收入的組成比例，並可能導致整體獲利能力的波動。供應商越來越重視其全球佈局，我們持續增加在全球供應商中的市佔率。對新興市場的敞口，特別是亞太及拉丁美洲，正驅動更高的成長與運營毛利率。新興市場通常因自動化程度較低，所需資本投資較少，我們在這些市場通常會有較高的運營毛利率，因這些市場的平均勞動成本較低。

我們的供應商包括許多最大的科技公司，包括 Advanced Micro Devices、Apple、Amazon Web Services (AWS)、Cisco、Dell Technologies、Hewlett Packard Enterprise、HP Inc.、Lenovo、Microsoft、NVIDIA 及 Super Micro Computer。Ingram Micro 在供應鏈限制存在時，因與供應商長期關係的強固，能更有效地取得產品。供應商通常根據全球覆蓋範圍、規模、合約條款、合作夥伴關係的強度及所提供的服務能力來選擇經銷商。

headings: 與我們業務及產業相關的風險
我們每季的營運結果有顯著波動。
我們的收購與投資策略可能無法產生預期效益，這可能會對我們的營運結果產生不利影響。
我們為一家控股公司，沒有直接營運活動。我們唯一的重大資產為透過間接股權投資於Ingram Micro Inc.，因此我們將依賴子公司提供現金以支應所有費用。
無法留住及招募關鍵人才將影響我們達成關鍵目標的能力。
工資與福利成本增加、集體談判協議、法律變更及其他勞動規範，或勞動動亂，可能會影響我們的財務狀況與現金流。
我們若無法適時因應產業變動，可能會對未來營運結果產生負面影響。
我們持續在所有市場面對我們產品與服務的激烈競爭。
我們的商譽及可辨認無形資產可能發生減損，這可能會降低我們資產的價值，並在減損發生的年度降低我們的淨收入。
我們無法預測涉及訴訟事項及其他偶發事件的結果。
我們已受到，且可能持續受到公共衛生問題的影響。

我們的業務在各個國際市場運作，包括某些較發達國傢俱有較高政治、經濟及社會不確定性的新興市場。
總體經濟與地緣政治條件的變化可能影響我們的業務與營運成果。
關稅、貿易及非貿易限制措施可能提高價格，並可能對本公司業務、營運結果、財務狀況及現金流產生不利影響。
